name: escape-lf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first '
'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-lower-crlf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = e'first '
	'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-cr
sql: UPDATE items SET name = E'first ''it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-three
escape-comment-lf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first ' -- note with ' version
'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-comment-crlf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first ' -- note with ' version
'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-mixed-whitespace
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first '  
	'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-single
sql: UPDATE items SET name = E'first it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: standard-continuation
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = 'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: independent-standard
sql: UPDATE items SET name = E'first ' || '\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: independent-escape
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'first ' || E'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: string-only-version
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first '
'it\'s version' WHERE id = 1;

name: comment-only-version
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first ' -- version comment
'it\'s' WHERE id = 1;

name: standard-final-backslash
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'first\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-name-lf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = name'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-name-crlf
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = NAME'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-qualified-comment
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = pg_catalog.name'first ' -- a type name ending in e
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-name-single
sql: UPDATE items SET name = name'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-digit-tail
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = name1e'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-underscore-tail
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = name_e'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-dollar-tail
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = name$e'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-utf8-tail
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = namée'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: quoted-type-control
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = "name"'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: standard-text-control
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = text'first '
'last\', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: escape-boundary-control
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = E'first '
'it\'s', version = version + 1 WHERE id = 1;

name: typed-string-only-version
sql:
UPDATE items SET name = name'first '
'last\ version' WHERE id = 1;
